results.detail: Unit 2 (scopeNote) is correct: no DTS:Configuration; [CRM] DTSX:4 and [SQL.GENERIX_STAGING] DTSX:53; the only OLE DB Commands on [CRM] are Update NeedToSendMailBit and Update sentToPrintOn; Kingsway (DTSX:23) is unused; the four agent-email scripts are commented out (DTSX:13989, 15683, 23130, 24705). Unit 1 is mostly correct: the CASE without ELSE, emailDetailsJson never read, the enrichment drop-outs, and the CSV split by agent/agency email all match. Three statements in unit 1 do not meet the standard. (a) 'תחזוקה יומית': the daily frequency comes only from the package name (PoaAccountUpdateDaily) and the folder name. No schedule is in the files, and the file name stamp is per run (_yyyy-MM-dd_HH_mm, DTSX:36911). (b) 'נשלח מייל סיכום, גם כשאין שורות': the mail is sent in Send Email PostExecute (main.cs:25-29). That PostExecute runs once per data-flow execution even with zero rows is SSIS lifecycle behaviour, not shown in the files, and the text does not mark it. It also only happens when Send Poa Emails runs, because all precedence constraints are Success. Also, the subject is the file name without its extension (main.cs:48-49), not 'שם קובץ הדיוור'. (c) 'לחשבונות ולתוכניות פנסיה ... נוצרים ייפויי כוח': in the pension flow, Remove Duplicates sorts on Gen_powerofattorneymainId only with EliminateDuplicates=true (DTSX:9066-9068). So per run only one new program per POA Main gets a POA. Not a defect, a note: the summary does not mention the annotation move (annotation.objectid Update via SDK, DTSX:3431 and 7722).

results.detail: The code is as described. Send Email PostExecute calls CreateAndSendEmail (main.cs:25-29). The email goes from the queue Guid.Parse(LibaSystemQueueId) to the queue Guid.Parse(MailingReportsCustomerTeamQueueId) (main.cs:55, 59), and the team name is labelled a hypothesis. But 'בכל ריצה, גם כשלא נוצרה אף שורת דיוור' rests on SSIS runtime behaviour that the files do not show: PostExecute is called once per data-flow execution even when the input gets zero rows. The finding does not mark this, as the standard requires. It also happens only in runs where Send Poa Emails executes, because every precedence constraint is Success. When rows exist but all go to the error file, the mail is sent too (that part follows from the paths).

results.detail: Source: Gen_startdate <= GETDATE() and Gen_currentstate = 3 (DTSX:27226). 'ממתין' for 3 is attributed in this package's open claim to the 0029:3889 SQL comment '-- waiting'. Lookup on an active POA (state 1) with the same isnull(account, program) key (DTSX:27081). Is Renewal compares agentcyIdNumberPa == agentcyIdNumber; Not Renewal (default) goes to Update NeedToSendMailBit. That component runs on [CRM] (DTSX:31302): CASE WHEN old Gen_appendixtype in 2/3/5 THEN Param_0 END, with Param_0 = Gen_receivingdatePoa = dateadd(HH,3,poa.gen_receivingdate) of the waiting POA and Param_1 = PowerOfAttorneyIdPa. AppendixType: 2/3/5 goes to the letter branch, and it is reached only via Not Renewal. Update Json updates WHERE PowerOfAttorneyId = ? and isProcessed = 0 and emailDetailsJson is null (DTSX:31256-31260). Activation sets gen_currentstate = 1 through the SDK (main.cs:32-50). Flow steps 1-5 match. Not a defect: when several active POAs exist, the summary does not mention which match is used. The detailed claim covers this.

The three branches match the paths. Lookup No Match goes to Union All Data To Update Status. Is Renewal Renewal goes to the Union. Not Renewal goes to Update NeedToSendMailBit, then AppendixType (NoMail to the Union; NeedToSendMail to Check Format, the email scripts (sync pass-through), Set Data, and the Union). All rows then go through Sort, Is emailDetailsJson Contains Data 1 (No Data), Multicast, and ACTIVE. Unit 8 places the SQL write and the JSON in the other-agent branch with the right conditions. Unit 10 is hedged correctly: activation holds 'unless the CRM update fails', and the text says the package does not read the JSON. No supplied DTSX reads emailDetailsJson in SQL (only 0030/0031 mention it, as a column).

wrongUnits.problem: 'אם יש כמה, נלקחת ההתאמה הראשונה' is SSIS Lookup behaviour (with duplicate keys in a full cache, the first row loaded is used). The file shows only CacheType=0; the behaviour is not shown in the files and the text does not mark it.

wrongUnits.problem: 'תוכניות פנסיה ... מקבלות ייפוי כוח פעיל אוטומטית' does not hold when several new programs share a POA Main. Only one program per POA Main gets a POA in each run.
wrongUnits.correct: '... מקבלות ייפוי כוח פעיל אוטומטית — תוכנית אחת לכל ייפוי כוח ראשי בכל ריצה (הסרת כפילויות לפי POA Main בלבד); תוכניות נוספות של אותו ייפוי כוח ראשי מטופלות רק בריצות הבאות, אם עדיין בטווח היומיים ועדיין אין להן ייפוי כוח.'
